analysis: The fusion-only trial completed successfully in 13.63 allocated GPU-seconds, but host validation macro HR@10 fell to 0.6062 from the supplied equal-rank result of 0.6162 and previous result of 0.6250. Category HR@10 was 0.645 Movies_and_TV, 0.625 Industrial_and_Scientific, 0.470 Electronics, and 0.685 CDs_and_Vinyl. Selecting alpha guarantees nondecrease only on the internal cached validation cases; it did not translate into improved host validation. The supplied output does not report the selected alpha or internal grid results, so expert superiority and the precise cause of the regression remain unproven. Successful execution confirms checkpoint reuse and export checks completed, not benchmark improvement.
code_summary: Preserved the independently selected residual MultVAE and SASRec experts without retraining. MultVAE combines a normalized binary-history EmbeddingBag encoder, 256 hidden units, a 64-dimensional variational latent, and a residual encoder-to-decoder path. SASRec retains chronological histories, default length 200, 50 hidden units, two attention blocks, and its existing 16-negative cross-entropy training objective. The evaluation path stages and hashes eight checkpoints, caches average descending expert ranks, evaluates global VAE weights {0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1}, and selects by macro validation HR@10 with deterministic tie-breaking. It exports fusion metadata and a matching four-category predictor, checking ties, permutations, endpoints, empty inputs, metadata reload, and score parity while preserving RNG state.
